mapping_rules.transcription: Each CDS-only teacher tx_pos[i] supervises the sum of full-elementary T7RNAP microstates at construct position 99+i.
mapping_rules.translation: Teacher tl_pos[0..L-1] supervise consecutive full elongation stages 2..L+1; teacher tl_pos[L] supervises termination/recycling microstates.
mapping_rules.initiation: Teacher ribosome-mRNA occupancy supervises the sum of gene-specific RS30S/RS70S initiation-assembly microstates containing mRNA.
